entities.summary: Julie Aviva Dabrusin is a Canadian lawyer and politician who has served as Minister of the Environment, Climate Change and Nature since 2025. A member of the Liberal Party, she has been a member of Parliament (MP) since the 2015 federal election, representing the riding of Toronto—Danforth in the House of Commons.
